text:
Happy afternoon all hands,
Calm finish behind us, one thing is left: lighting levels

Please treat the companion spaces with the same care we expect on every live transfer. Softer illumination reduces agitation, supports steady movement, and gives handlers a clearer read on posture and breathing. Keep doors closed until the path is ready, avoid harsh overhead changes, and report any fixture that flickers or leaves a blind corner. I expect each handoff to remain calm, humane, and quiet.

For the pet lounge, maintain clean lanes and do not crowd carriers near the entry point. <<FACT F001>> Confirm that signage is visible, water access is unobstructed, and floor checks are completed before any animal is brought through. If a traveler appears uncertain, answer in a warm professional tone and move with care rather than speed. When the routing desk receives a late change, document it at once and alert the senior coordinator without delay.

Please also keep the Merrowgate notes current. <<FACT F023>> <<FACT F011>> Review all carrier labels, verify that records match the animal being moved, and refuse any transfer that raises welfare concerns. If Diego Williams or Sofia Garcia appears at the counter with Sasha, offer direct guidance, but do not improvise around the safety rules. The standard remains simple: steady handling, clear communication, and prompt escalation whenever conditions drift from safe practice. Thank you for maintaining disciplined attention to detail.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
